description.value: The Enderby Memorial Arena is a community ice rink housed within the John Pritchard Memorial Sports Complex, serving as a central social hub in the small city of Enderby in the North Okanagan. With bleacher seating for up to 900 spectators, it supports public skating, youth hockey leagues, and skating lessons through the ice season. The building also operates as a dry floor rental venue from April through August, keeping it active as a community gathering space year-round.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms the facility address as 1605 Kate Street and explicitly lists 'concession, dressing rooms, and washroom facilities' as part of the arena. No mention of bike parking, bike racks, showers, or any cycling-specific amenities appears anywhere in the website content. The general recreation services phone (250.838.2665) is confirmed across multiple subpages; OSM had no phone entry, so there is nothing to cross-check there.
concerns: OSM sport tag is 'lacrosse' but the facility is primarily an ice skating and public hockey venue
No phone number present in OSM; number sourced from website (250.838.2665)

enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: This is a community ice and dry-floor arena with confirmed washrooms and a concession, which may provide useful amenity stops for passing cyclists, but it has no confirmed bike parking and limited appeal as a dedicated cycling tourism attraction; its inclusion depends on whether the WWC directory intends to list general community amenity waypoints.

Café or food on site.detail: Website lists 'concession' as a named facility feature of the arena

wow_evidence: Community rink with public skating; KW-PRIVATE is a dry-floor-rental false positive.
blurb: Enderby's memorial arena in the Pritchard sports complex.
